constraints: If enterList is omitted, Enter-in-list mode is disabled by default; if selectMode is omitted, Multiple Selection mode is used by default.
During and after execution, records the user highlights are kept in a set named UserSet, available to object methods and to the calling method after DISPLAY SELECTION completes.

overloadMerges.note: The draft gave both trailing '*' parameters the identical name '*' and generic in-direction; the docs show they are two independent, order-dependent literal-symbol flags (the second only has meaning when the first is also passed), so they need distinct names/descriptions and a jointConstraint.

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table to display, or Default table, if omitted

params.name: selectMode
params.description: Selection mode: pass one of the 'Form Parameters' theme constants (No selection=0, Single selection=1, Multiple selection=2); defaults to Multiple selection

params.name: enterList
params.description: True to authorize the 'Enter in list' mode (selection of values in the list, not modification); defaults to False

params.name: useOutputFormForOneRecord
params.description: If present, a one-record selection is displayed using the output form (instead of the input form), and scroll bars are hidden if the user double-clicks into the input form

params.name: showScrollBars
params.description: If present, reverses the scroll-bar-hiding effect of the first optional '*', showing scroll bars in the input form again

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Displays the selection of aTable as a scrollable list using the output form, letting the user select (and optionally enter-in-list edit) records.

jointConstraints.rule: showScrollBars only has an effect when useOutputFormForOneRecord is also passed; it overrides that flag's scroll-bar-hiding behavior.
